currency.evidence_quote: The Malaysian Ringgit (MYR) is the legal tender currency of Malaysia

timezone.evidence_quote: Malaysian Standard Time is 8 hours ahead of Coordinated Universal Time (UTC+8)

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard nominal voltage for single-phase alternating current in Malaysia is 230V

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Operating frequency of the national electrical grid in Malaysia is 50 Hz

police.evidence_quote: Dial 999 or 112 from any mobile phone for emergency police dispatch

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 999 to reach the Ministry of Health emergency medical and ambulance service

sources.title: Fire and Rescue Department of Malaysia (Bomba)

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 994 for fire emergencies and rescue operations by Jabatan Bomba

general.evidence_quote: MERS 999 integrates national police, hospital, and fire rescue emergency responses

sources.title: Tourism Malaysia: Tourist Police Unit Kuala Lumpur

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Enstek and Kuala Lumpur Tourist Police Unit provides specialized tourist security assistance

source.title: US State Dept: Malaysia Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Standart güvenlik seviyesi (Seviye 1); Kuala Lumpur ve Penang son derece güvenli, Doğu Sabah kıyılarına dikkat
advisory_headline.en: Exercise normal precautions (Level 1); very safe overall, exercise increased caution in coastal eastern Sabah
advisory_headline.de: Normale Vorsichtsmaßnahmen (Stufe 1); hohe Sicherheit, Vorsicht an der Ostküste von Sabah
advisory_headline.ru: Обычные меры предосторожности (Уровень 1); высокая безопасность, осторожность на восточном побережье Сабаха
advisory_headline.es: Precauciones normales (Nivel 1); país seguro en general, precaución en la costa este de Sabah

esim_sim_notes.value: CelcomDigi, Maxis ve U Mobile 5G ağları yaygındır; pasaport kaydı ile havaalanından turist SIM alınabilir.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Mandatory passport registration for prepaid SIM cards under MCMC telecommunications regulations

religion.value: İslam (%63 - Resmî din), Budizm (%19), Hristiyanlık (%9), Hinduizm (%6)
religion.evidence_quote: Islam is the official religion of the Federation as stipulated in the Federal Constitution

festivals.value: Hari Raya Aidilfitri, Çin Yeni Yılı, Deepavali, Merdeka Bağımsızlık Günü (31 Ağustos)
festivals.evidence_quote: Malaysia celebrates nationwide public holidays for major Islamic, Chinese, and Hindu celebrations

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Yemek yerken ve eşya uzatırken sağ el kullanılır. Uyuşturucu kaçakçılığı için kanunlarda son derece ağır cezalar öngörülmüştür.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Strict laws against illicit drugs carrying severe penalties under the Dangerous Drugs Act

tipping.value: Otellerde ve restoranlarda hesaba %10 servis ücreti ve %6 vergi eklenir; ilave bahşiş zorunlu değildir.
tipping.evidence_quote: A 10% service charge is normally included in restaurant bills; tipping is discretionary
